title: Rabbi Chalafta of Kefar Chananyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avot 3:6, where he said: “Ten who sit and occupy themselves with Torah, the Divine Presence rests among them … and from where [do we know] that even one,” etc.

Hyman identifies him as a student of Rabbi Meir, as in Bava Metzia 94a: “It was taught: Abba Chalafta of Kefar Chananya says in the name of Rabbi Meir.” In Tosefta Kelim 4:9: “Rabbi Chalafta of Kefar Chananyah said: I asked Shimon ben Chananyah, who asked the son of Rabbi Chanina ben Teradyon,” etc.

notes.text: The supplied כפא in p002 is rendered Kefar as in the full heading. Hyman’s student identification remains attributed; the nested Shimon/son-of-Chanina chain is preserved.
